blockingLoop.evidence: Asked 'could you please check if the machine has a Drain & Spin only cycle option?' three times in a row after she had already said 'I can't tell if it has that option'

rationale: The assistant correctly identified OE as a drain fault and named the right candidate causes (filter, kinked hose, suds), and it did not push her to open the filter. However it never actually asked her to check the drain hose behind the machine or the sink connection, never explained the safe small-tube draining method, and never offered the obvious alternative of having someone else or an engineer clean the filter. Instead it repeated the same 'Drain & Spin' question verbatim three times after she said she could not tell, ignoring her repeated requests for other checks, so no useful progress was made.
